purpose: Plants without a verified nutrition record and why (no values are stored here).
policy: Hold entries never carry nutrient values. A plant leaves this list only when an exact species + plant part + raw-state record from a named official dataset or peer-reviewed source is verified into data/plant_nutrition_v56.json.
sources_searched: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy Foods JSON 2018-04 (all 7,793 foods)
USDA FoodData Central Foundation Foods JSON 2026-04-30 (363 foods)
